description: Defines data models for 'Category' and 'Product' used in an online shopping app, including related utility methods for product pricing and display logic.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a product category with an id and name.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product with various attributes including pricing, description, images, and sale information, along with utility methods for price formatting and description retrieval.

methods.name: formattedPrice
methods.description: Returns the product price formatted as a string with a dollar sign and two decimal places.

methods.name: formattedPriceFromCents
methods.description: Returns a given price in cents formatted as a dollar string.

methods.name: hasMultipleImages
methods.description: Checks if the product has more than one image URL.

methods.name: effectiveLongDescription
methods.description: Returns the longer description if available and non-blank; otherwise, returns the short description.

methods.name: effectiveSalePriceCents
methods.description: Returns the sale price in cents if the product is on sale, the sale price is valid, and less than the original price; otherwise, null.

methods.name: effectiveDiscountPercent
methods.description: Calculates the discount percentage based on sale price and original price, considering explicit discount and effective sale price.
